description: The signed-in couple's own wedding registry on Zola: change the name, the goal, goal_hidden or the note of 1 cash fund on the registry. Get the registry_item_id of a cash fund from zola_search_my_registry_items. Give only the fields to change: the others stay as they are. The goal cannot go below what guests gave. goal_hidden hides or shows the goal and the amount given; left out, it stays as it is. A goal on a fund of gifts of 1 amount that no guest gave to changes it to any amount toward the goal, as zola.com does. An empty note removes the note. Status possible_duplicate: another cash fund has the new name, and Zola changed nothing. If the couple wants 2 funds with that name, give the match_id of each match in ignore_match_ids. Guests see the change at once. Every cash fund of zola.com has a goal: no tool and no page removes a goal, but goal_hidden hides it. The picture and a removal of the fund are on zola.com. A call without confirm_token changes nothing: it returns a preview with a confirm_token. Show the preview to the couple. Call again with the same arguments and the confirm_token only after the couple says yes. Requires Zola sign-in (account:write).

confirm_token.description: The confirm_token of the preview. Give it only after the couple said yes to that preview, with the same arguments

goal_cents.description: The new goal in US cents. Not below what guests gave. On a fund of gifts of 1 amount that no guest gave to, it changes the fund to any amount toward this goal, as zola.com does

goal_hidden.description: true hides the goal and the amount given from guests, false shows them ("Hide total" on zola.com). Left out: as it is

ignore_match_ids.description: The match_id of each other fund of a possible_duplicate preview, when the couple says that she wants 2 funds with the new name

name.description: The new name that guests see

note.description: The new note for guests. An empty text removes the note

registry_item_id.description: The registry_item_id of a cash fund from zola_search_my_registry_items

name: zola_update_my_registry_cash_fund

outputSchema.description: The preview or the result of a cash fund change on the registry of the signed-in couple

cannot_undo.description: What the change removes and Zola cannot restore

changed.description: True only when this call changed the registry

confirm_token.description: Give it to zola_update_my_registry_cash_fund with the same arguments, only after the couple says yes

expires_at.description: The end of the validity of confirm_token, ISO 8601 UTC

links.description: The zola.com pages for this data

records.description: The cash funds with a change, in the order of the call

removal.description: True when the change removes or overwrites a value

id.description: The id of the record, as zola_search_my_registry_items gives it

matches.description: With possible_duplicate: the records that look like the new one

id.description: Give it in ignore_match_ids when the couple wants the new record beside this one

name.description: The record, as the couple knows it

version.description: The version of the record as this call read it

removal_count.description: 1 when the call removes the note of the fund

replayed.description: True when this is the stored result of an earlier call with the same confirm_token

status.description: preview: nothing changed, confirm_token makes the change. nothing_to_change: nothing to change, no confirm_token. done: changed. draft_changed: nothing changed, a new preview. record_changed: nothing changed, read again

title: Update My Registry Cash Fund
